Melyik eszköz dolgozzon. A három JEV-es: Which tool does the work. The three paths with JEV differ in how the system reads the data of a document of a recognised type; the ‘GPT only’ path works without JEV. Every path is followed by checks in code (for example the tax number's check digit, the totals adding up); whatever is uncertain becomes a to-do.
A JEV ismeri fel az irat típusát és a le: JEV recognises the document's type and the email's intent, and the document type's recommended path runs: S on Hungarian and foreign invoices, G on utility bills (because of the line items), G on the other document types, which only have a G path. Recommended for everyday work.
A kód kigyűjti a lehetséges értékeket, a: The code collects the possible values and JEV chooses among them field by field. Cheaper, does not read line items. On the eight invoice types (Hungarian and foreign invoices, six utility bills) only JEV calls. The other document types have no JEV path: they run on the G path (GPT + JEV) so that their data is read too, which is why they get an OpenAI budget as well.
JEV nélkül, csak az OpenAI (GPT) dolgozi: Without JEV, only OpenAI (GPT) works. GPT recognises the document's type (about 0.001–0.002 USD per document), and every document runs on the G path: GPT reads the data and the code checks it (every extracted value must be printed on the document, and the check-digit, amount and required-field checks remain). Measured on the golden set (2026-10-02): GPT recognised the type of 99 of 102 documents (JEV all 102) and stated its 3 errors confidently too; two of them get a to-do (one from a check in code: the type presumes a Hungarian issuer, but GPT says the issuer is not Hungarian), one can pass without a to-do. 27 of the 1010 fields of the 70 golden documents differed from the checked value. GPT also recognises the emails' intent, with the same questions as JEV (94 hits on the 96-email golden set, the 2 errors went to manual review; about 0.0025 USD per email, from a budget of at most 0.07 USD); the PDF attachments run as documents. The run gets no JEV budget, so no JEV call can happen.
A JEV ismeri fel a levél szándékát; a PD: JEV recognises the email's intent; the PDF attachments run as documents, on the automatic path. This is the default.
